name: Roads & Infrastructure
description: Damaged, blocked, or unsafe roads, bridges, footpaths, and related civic infrastructure.

name: Water Supply
description: Issues with drinking water availability, quality, leakage, or supply disruption.

name: Sanitation & Waste Management
description: Garbage collection failures, illegal dumping, overflowing bins, and public cleanliness issues.

name: Electricity
description: Power outages, exposed wiring, transformer faults, and other electrical-supply hazards.

name: Public Safety
description: Immediate safety hazards to the public, including accidents, fire risk, or unsafe structures.

name: Streetlight
description: Non-functional, damaged, or missing streetlights affecting night-time safety.

name: Drainage
description: Blocked, broken, or overflowing drainage and sewage systems.

name: Public Health
description: Health hazards affecting the community, such as disease outbreaks, pest infestation, or unsanitary conditions.

name: Environment
description: Pollution, illegal tree felling, and other environmental degradation concerns.

name: Public Transport
description: Issues with buses, transit stops, and other public transportation infrastructure or service.

name: Government Services
description: Complaints about delays, corruption, or dysfunction in government offices and public service delivery.

name: Other
description: Any valid civic complaint that does not fit an existing category. Requires manual review before routing.
